lessons.title: Ang Alpabeto: A, B, K, D, E
lessons.summary: Alamin ang tunog, hugis at Braille ng mga unang letra.

cards.heading: Ang Alpabetong Filipino
cards.text: Ang alpabetong Filipino ay may dalawampu't walong letra.
cards.translation: The Filipino alphabet has 28 letters. We will start with A, B, K, D and E.

cards.heading: Ang letrang A
cards.translation: A is for aso, which means dog. Shape: two slanted lines that meet at the top, with a bar across the middle. Braille: dot 1.

cards.heading: Ang letrang B
cards.translation: B is for bahay, which means house. Shape: a straight line on the left with two bumps on the right. Braille: dots 1 and 2.

cards.heading: Ang letrang K
cards.translation: K is for kamay, which means hand. Shape: a straight line with two short arms on the right. Braille: dots 1 and 3.

cards.heading: Ang letrang D
cards.translation: D is for dahon, which means leaf. Shape: a straight line on the left with one big bump on the right. Braille: dots 1, 4 and 5.

cards.heading: Ang letrang E
cards.translation: E is for elepante, which means elephant. Shape: a straight line with three short bars pointing right. Braille: dots 1 and 5.

cards.heading: Magandang umaga
cards.translation: Good morning. Adding po makes it polite when you speak to elders.

cards.heading: Magandang hapon at gabi
cards.text: Magandang hapon po. Magandang gabi po.

cards.heading: Magbilang tayo
cards.translation: Let's count: one, two, three! Touch one finger for each number.

lessons.title: Ang Aking Pamilya
lessons.summary: Mga salita para sa miyembro ng pamilya.

cards.heading: Nanay at tatay
cards.text: Ito ang nanay ko. Ito ang tatay ko.
cards.translation: This is my mother. This is my father.

cards.heading: Kuya at ate
cards.text: Si kuya ay mas matanda sa akin. Si ate ay mas matanda rin sa akin.
cards.translation: Kuya is my older brother. Ate is my older sister.

cards.heading: Lolo at lola
cards.text: Mahal ko si lolo at si lola.
cards.translation: I love my grandfather and my grandmother.
